description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LeaveOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It tests various aspects of the LeaveOverlapAPI such as validation rules, API methods (create, delete, get), and access control for different query parameters.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, covering validation, API methods, and access controls.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture data from a YAML file before each test method runs.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method is not implemented (expecting exception).

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the getValidationRuleForDelete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the getValidationRuleForCreate method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getAll API endpoint with various query parameters, including edge cases like invalid or missing parameters.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Runs integration tests for getAll API endpoint with different test cases provided by dataProviderForTestGetAll.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the getAll method.
